versions.summary: Original built-in thick-contact/rigid profile; select legacy-secondary-physics with historical quality settings.
5 mm node contacts; moderate bending and shape restoration; early walking tuning.
3 mm contacts, free drape, softer springs and damping.
Drape plus palm proxies and skirt-edge hand contacts; previous Anon live default.
Locked bangs, smooth skirt skinning, 1.02 stretch cap and contact release damping. Contains Mutsumi geometry/bone IDs; not a universal material preset.
Direct Anon drape transfer; excessive skirt roll-up on Girls.
Direct native angular limits reduced roll-up; excessive temporal jitter remained.
Balanced edge mass/damping, fewer redundant constraints; residual leg-contact snap.
Compliant cone limits, 25 ms contact damping rise, 20 ms normal blending. Accepted on Mutsumi and Anon Girls first 30 seconds at 240 Hz in original test rigs.
Previous accepted120Hz default, preserved unchanged for reproduction.
Approved V4 graded waist support + V3 firmer fabric + V2 hair-skirt node/edge contacts.120Hz cloth; geometry, body motion and skirt length retained.
V5 named side-hair root anchors and graded recovery; all V4 skirt/fabric/hair-cloth settings retained;120Hz cloth. Unmatched bone prefixes have no effect.

experimental_notes: Intermediate A/B/C/D files remain in output/mutsumi_girls_* directories. Rejected pre-contact cushion/480 Hz trials are not in the default. Skirt shortening 10/20/30 percent directories are geometry variations, not separate universal physics templates.
validation_scope: Mutsumi Girls40s V4 accepted; Anon Girls40s V5 side-hair accepted. No claim of full-dance visual acceptance on other models.
